title: Conformance matrix + assistive‑tech scenario mapping for component library
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a machine- and human-readable conformance matrix mapping our core component surface to applicable WCAG 2.2 criteria and cover concrete assistive-technology (AT) scenarios for engineering validation. Scope: tokens, buttons, form controls, tables (virtualized and paginated), and charts (SVG/canvas). Deliverables: 1) Conformance matrix (CSV + Confluence table). 2) Assistive‑tech scenario deck with step-by-step repros for VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS. 3) Minimal remediation playbook (design token changes, keyboard patterns, ARIA guidance). 4) Draft VPAT section for DS components. Out-of-scope: full engineering remediations (handled in follow-up ENG tickets).
acceptance_criteria: Matrix enumerates all core components and maps to explicit WCAG success criteria (e.g., 1.3.1, 2.1.1, 1.4.3) with severity and recommended fix
At least 12 AT scenarios documented (VoiceOver/NVDA/JAWS + keyboard) with steps and expected output
Design token recommendations include explicit contrast pairs, accessible token aliases, and a migration plan
Prototype pages demonstrate keyboard traversal and screen-reader output for Table (virtualized), Button variants, and Chart legends
VPAT draft prepared for legal/infosec review and linked to the confluence page
tasks: Run an inventory audit of DS components and capture current state in spreadsheet (owner: Sofia)
Create assistive-tech test harness pages in staging (owner: Miguel Ortega)
Perform manual screen-reader passes and record audio + notes (owner: Sofia)
Identify token contrast failures and propose replacement tokens with accessible aliases (owner: Aisha)
Prototype keyboard flow for virtualized table rows and chart legend focus order (owner: Design + Eng pairing)
Draft conformance matrix and export CSV for engineering teams
Open engineering follow-up tickets for high-severity items (ENG-xxxx) and add to dependencies
Circulate VPAT draft to Legal and Security for review and capture feedback
comments: 2026-02-10 Aisha Patel: Ticket created after DS triage. Initial goal is to stop ad-hoc accessibility fixes and produce a repeatable matrix and AT scenarios that eng can run against staging. Linking initial inventory: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcdExample

2026-02-15 Sofia Chen: Completed first-pass inventory for Buttons and Form controls. Noted contrast failures in ghost/secondary button variants and missing focus-visible outline in compact density. Spreadsheet tab: Buttons. https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/ButtonsAudit

2026-02-18 Miguel Ortega (engineering): Set up staging harness at https://staging.redwood.internal/ds-a11y-harness. Found virtualized table uses aria-rowindex but no aria-posinset; this causes VoiceOver to announce incorrect row numbers. Suggest adding aria-posinset when virtualization is active.

2026-02-22 Aisha Patel: Design decision — avoid using role=application for chart groupings; instead supply accessible descriptions and keyboard patterns to keep standard browse mode for screen-readers. Rationale: role=application breaks native shortcut keys and leads to unpredictable behavior in JAWS.

2026-02-26 Sofia Chen: Ran NVDA pass on Windows for tables. Observed: virtualized rows are skipped when row-height changes; temporary mitigation is to ensure stable DOM order during keyboard navigation. Logged findings in spreadsheet and linked ENG follow-ups. https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/ENG-23145

2026-03-02 Evelyn Park (PM): Reviewed matrix draft. Requested explicit customer-impact field per row (none/low/medium/high) and an estimated engineering cost column. Updated acceptance criteria to include severity and owner columns.

2026-03-06 Accessibility consultant (external): Performed sampling on Chart legend voiceover output. Recommendation: include aria-labels on legend entries and map keyboard left/right to move between series names. Added to playbook.
2026-03-10 Sofia Chen: Assembling VPAT draft for DS components. Draft link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/DS/VPAT+Draft+2026-03. Next: legal review and convert findings into ENG tickets.
